opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability – Round 1 (2026)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities (with a ‘Good’ regulator rating) undertaking capital projects (new build, refurbishment or equipment) with a shortfall of at least £25,000 and total capital costs of at least £50,000. Projects must improve access, quality or sustainability of services for people with disability, especially training, employment and supported housing.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working with disability to support new buildings, refurbishment or equipment that increase independence, training, employment and supported housing for people with disability.
